claims.assertion: Athena says the Federation does not practically intervene for humanity and alleges it repeatedly violates its own noninterference rules.

claims.qualifiers: She presents this as her assessment of Federation conduct.

claims.assertion: Athena describes past and future timelines as possibilities converging on an observer’s present, with thoughts and frequency influencing which future is experienced.
claims.speaker: Athena Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She says future predictions are not definitive.
